messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's skirt with the item shown in the reference images, matching its design, color, and details from the front and back views. Keep all other clothing, footwear, and non-clothing attributes unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's skirt with the item shown in the reference images. Keep all other clothing, footwear, and non-clothing attributes unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street, then turns and dances, swinging her arms and twisting her body.","camera":"A vertical, medium full-body shot from behind that slowly moves closer and follows the character's rotation.","clothing":"She wears a pink-and-white gingham off-shoulder top with white puffy sleeves and a split white-and-black skirt, plus light blue sneakers.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Hair is styled into two high buns on top of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, shown from behind.","scene":"A hazy, old-style town street with brick buildings, shop signs, a Union Jack flag, and a cobblestone road."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original black skirt with gold floral pattern was replaced by a black-and-white split skirt. The output shows a white panel on the character's left side and a black panel on the right, with an asymmetric hem and a small dark mark on the white panel, consistent with the reference views. The top, hair, hairstyle, shoes, scene, and motion remain largely unchanged.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's skirt with the reference black-and-white split skirt, matching its design, color, and details from front and back, while keeping all other clothing, footwear, and non-clothing attributes unchanged.
uncertain: Exact side-to-side orientation of the white and black panels relative to the reference front view is difficult to verify from the mostly rear-facing video.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly brighter/more washed out than the source, especially in the sky and background.
